lore.text: A unicorn's horn is delicate and very sensitive. Touching another pony's horn is deeply personal: only close friends and partners may, and even then it makes a unicorn shy and flustered. A stranger grabbing a horn is a serious breach of manners, and a unicorn will push them away with a jolt of magic. A horn stroked for long enough by someone she trusts can overflow with a harmless burst of sparkles in her magic colour, which leaves her blushing.
